declaration: fix-declaration.json, committed before any fix code (tag fix-before)
outcome: Gate did NOT move. Rooms with at least one dimension: 0 of 1 before, 0 of 1 after, on all three runs.

runs.finding: Derived stills were rotated 90 degrees; Stray logs the sensor in landscape orientation.
After rotating stills upright using logged gravity, the estimator found no qualifying floor/ceiling plane pair in the 7 derived stills. This does not prove that both surfaces were visually absent.

On single_scan_with_ceiling, whose LiDAR run gives a candidate 2.33 m height, the single-view estimator again found no qualifying plane pair. Narrow views, depth error and camera assumptions may contribute.

prediction_check: The conditional forecast permitted 0 of 1, but that is not prediction validation or meaningful gate movement. The success target of 1 of 1 was not met.
root_cause_verdict: Incomplete. SfM fails on sparse stills and the pipeline did discard per-image depth, but the fallback found no supported floor/ceiling pair in one view. Missing observations, learned-depth error and assumed focal length/gravity may all contribute. Cross-view scale or gravity is unresolved; this was not fixed by the fallback.
what_shipped: Single-view fallback (precision over recall: no value if floor and ceiling planes are not both found and parallel), upright derivation, rectangle layout default, damage opt-in.
not_claimed: No accuracy movement and no photo-tier gate pass. Intervals remain uncalibrated; no physical ground truth.
protocol_change_from_finding: docs/CAPTURE_PROTOCOL.md asks for a level wide shot per room from a doorway showing floor and ceiling together; this proposal is not physically validated.
next: Estimate camera height and gravity from several views (cross-view planes) or require a wide shot, then re-declare before changing code.
